# Candidate: fill q-projection overlap only for pairs whose line row spans overlap
sel=[(6,11),(6,15),(15,23)]
out_rowpairs=[row[:] for row in grid]
for p1,p2 in sel:
    rset1=[(p+q)//2 for q in lines[p1]]
    rset2=[(p+q)//2 for q in lines[p2]]
    if max(min(rset1),min(rset2))>min(max(rset1),max(rset2)): continue
    qlo=max(min(lines[p1]),min(lines[p2])); qhi=min(max(lines[p1]),max(lines[p2]))
    for p in range(p1+1,p2):
        for q in range(qlo,qhi+1):
            if (p+q)%2==0:
                rr=(p+q)//2; cc=(p-q)//2
                if 0<=rr<16 and 0<=cc<16 and out_rowpairs[rr][cc]==8: out_rowpairs[rr][cc]=2
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out_rowpairs))
print([(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(out_rowpairs) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==2])
